description: PySCF RHF in PySCF's own basis, CASCI active-space integrals in its MO basis (E_core and h_eff from get_h1eff, (tu|vw) from get_h2eff restored to n^4, chemists' order, row-major), and fci.direct_spin1's lowest roots over them (conv_tol 1e-13, checked against the dense spectrum): total energy (hartree, E_core included), <S^2>, and the spin-summed 1-RDM; coordinates in bohr
